address: La Route de la Baie, St Brelade, Jersey,JE3 8EF
bio: Escape the every day to this charming St Brelade’s Bay resort, L’Horizon Beach Hotel & Spa, for the ultimate, quintessential dining experience. Stunning coastal views create the perfect backdrop to indulge in Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea at L’Horizon Beach Hotel & Spa is served in the Atlantic Lounge with beautiful views over the grounds, and to the sea beyond. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. The elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  Enjoy the age-old tradition of a traditional Afternoon Tea with an array of savoury treats, scones, and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. Theyalso refresh our menu regularly to celebrate various occasions and celebrations throughout the year.  They pride themselves on catering for a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan, and special children's Afternoon Tea options. As the crowning touch, upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury.
